title: Following nested loops
description: You can track a complete inner loop for each outer-loop value.

steps.description: The outer loop gives row the values 0, 1 and 2. You run its indented body for each value.
The inner loop gives col the values 0 and 1. It starts again for each new row.

steps.question: How many lines will the print produce?
steps.answer: Six lines. Each of the three rows pairs with both column values.

steps.description: You see row 0 with columns 0 and 1, then the same column sequence for rows 1 and 2. The final line is row 2 col 1.
